guides.title: Frostrail Guides – Survive the Cold and Master Your Train
guides.introduction: Start with warmth, food, clothing, and the Eden Engine, then learn how to prepare an expedition, handle scarce ammunition, craft what the crew needs, and keep a one-to-four-player run moving north.
guides.heroImageAlt: Frostrail players on an expedition across a frozen level

topics.title: Getting started
topics.label: Core loop
topics.description: Frostrail alternates between preparing aboard the train and exploring frozen levels for materials, equipment, relics, and a route onward.
details: The train is the crew's mobile base and a fail state if destroyed
Levels can contain multiple exits leading to the next destination
Progression now carries between levels in the current development build

topics.title: Cold, heat, food & clothing
topics.label: Survival
topics.description: Cold is the central environmental pressure. Blizzards can blind, slow, and eventually suffocate players; warmer clothing and some foods help mitigate exposure.
details: Heat is a survival requirement around the Eden Engine
Food grants buffs rather than serving as a mandatory hunger meter
Multiple new clothing sets were reported in the May 2026 update

topics.title: Combat & weapons
topics.label: Firearms first
topics.description: The developers describe a guns-first combat model with WWI-influenced pistols, shotguns, rifles, machine guns, and basic melee options.
details: All guns are planned to be craftable and modular
Ranged weapons have a secondary melee attack
Exact damage, ammunition, rarity, and balance values have not been officially published

source.label: GamingBolt interview with lead designer Ez Jämsen

topics.title: Operate the train
topics.label: Mobile base
topics.description: Crews must fuel, power, drive, maintain, expand, and defend the Eden Engine while using it for warmth, storage, crafting, and travel.
details: Logs, branches, and charcoal have been discussed as fuel inputs
Walls, hatches, doors, stations, storage, and carriages are planned upgrades
A broken or destroyed Eden Engine ends the run

topics.title: Crafting & repair
topics.label: Production
topics.description: Crafting ties recovered materials to weapons, train improvements, equipment, and dedicated onboard workstations.
details: Metal scraps can be refined into slag metal and then pure metal
Wood and plastic use similar refinement chains
Weapon modification and repair use dedicated onboard workstations

topics.title: Co-op crew planning
topics.label: 1–4 players
topics.description: Frostrail supports single-player and online co-op for one to four players. No fixed character classes have been announced.
details: Steam lists both single-player and online co-op
The official FAQ confirms crews of one to four
Controller support is planned, but may not be ready at Early Access launch

wiki.title: Frostrail Wiki – Weapons, Items, Relics and Game Systems
wiki.introduction: Look up the weapons, tools, resources, crafting stations, Relics, clothing, food, and world details known so far. Each section starts with what matters during a run, while build-specific values are clearly dated when they may still change.
wiki.heroImageAlt: Frostrail weapon assembly and modular parts interface

topics.title: Weapons
topics.label: 2 named weapons + 5 archetypes
topics.description: Pipe Rifle and Bolt-Action Rifle are the two publicly named weapons found in developer interviews. Pistols, shotguns, rifles, machine guns, and basic melee are confirmed archetypes.
details: Pipe Rifle: described as an early-game weapon
Bolt-Action Rifle: shown as a modular firearm example
Damage, ammo type, rarity, magazine size, range, and weight: TBA

topics.title: Items & equipment
topics.label: Confirmed categories
topics.description: Official material confirms scavenged supplies, weapons, equipment, food, clothing, and train-related components, but it does not yet publish a complete item list.
details: Scavenge, hunt, and craft equipment
Ammo is intentionally valuable and combat is serious
Individual item names, stacks, weights, and rarities: TBA

topics.title: Resources
topics.label: 6 named materials + fuel
topics.description: Branches, logs, charcoal, metal, cloth, and plastic are named resources. Developer interviews also describe a metal-scrap refinement chain and the broader fuel system.
details: Branches / logs / charcoal: discussed as Eden Engine fuel
Metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Wood and plastic have similar refining steps; exact yields remain TBA

topics.title: Crafting
topics.label: Weapons, train & stations
topics.description: Crafting supports weapons and equipment, train reinforcement and expansion, cooking, repair, storage, and modular weapon modification.
details: Crafting benches and refineries can be added to the train
Metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal is a developer-described chain
Recipe counts, processing times, and final balance remain TBA

topics.title: Relics
topics.label: Dungeon rewards
topics.description: Relics are found in dungeons and activated aboard the train to grant temporary buffs. Individual names and effect values remain unpublished.
details: Found in dungeons
Activated on the train
Temporary buffs
Names, rarity tiers, duration, and exact effects: TBA

topics.title: Clothing
topics.label: Cold mitigation
topics.description: Warmer clothing mitigates cold exposure. The developers reported multiple new clothing sets in May 2026, but have not published their names or statistics.
details: Primary confirmed role: cold mitigation
Multiple clothing sets exist in development
Slots, durability, warmth values, set bonuses, and recipes: TBA

topics.title: Food
topics.label: Buffs, not hunger
topics.description: Food is crafted at a cooking station and grants meaningful buffs, including health-related benefits. Frostrail is not planned around a mandatory hunger meter.
details: Cooking station confirmed
Food can improve health and other statistics
Certain foods may help against cold
Recipes, durations, and values: TBA

topics.title: Train stations
topics.label: Onboard work areas
topics.description: Confirmed onboard facilities include crafting benches, refineries, cooking, weapon modification, repair, and storage-related systems.
details: Facilities can be added as the train is expanded
They convert recovered resources into survival capacity
Official station names, costs, sizes, and upgrade trees: TBA

topics.title: World & lore
topics.label: Penitent Gardeners
topics.description: Players are Penitent Gardeners traveling a former empire frozen after its Emperor made a pact with the Void. The lead designer describes background lore as present, while survival systems remain the gameplay driver.
details: Player faction: Penitent Gardeners
Threats: Revenants and eldritch horrors
Tone: tension and action rather than a dedicated horror game

topics.title: How we check information
topics.label: Editorial standard
topics.description: Game builds and current Steam pages come first. Development posts and named interviews help explain systems that are still changing, but mockups and placeholder dates are never treated as final gameplay data.
details: Build-specific numbers include a date or test context
Developer plans are kept separate from playable features
Screenshots can support visible UI values, not unseen mechanics
Missing values are left unpublished instead of guessed

train.title: Frostrail Train Guide – Build, Power and Defend the Eden Engine
train.introduction: The Eden Engine is your transport, shelter, workshop, storage, and main source of heat. Learn how fuel, power, carriages, upgrades, and defenses work together—and why losing the train can end the crew's journey.
train.heroImageAlt: Inside the Eden Engine locomotive cab in Frostrail

topics.title: Eden Engine
topics.label: Core locomotive
topics.description: The Eden Engine is the crew's mobile fortress and the heart of the run. It must be fueled, powered, driven, maintained, and defended.
details: Provides travel, heat, power, crafting space, and storage
Engine upgrades affect speed and pulling weight
Its destruction is a developer-stated game-over condition; exact stats remain TBA

topics.title: Upgrades
topics.label: Reinforcement
topics.description: The train can be reinforced and customized with walls, hatches, doors, weapon stations, crafting facilities, and engine improvements.
details: Engine upgrades affect speed and pulling weight
More carriages require more power
Upgrade costs, names, and unlock order remain TBA

topics.title: Carriages
topics.label: Expansion
topics.description: Additional carriages expand the mobile base and create room for crafting stations, storage, protection, and crew functions.
details: More carriages increase the Eden Engine's pulling-weight and power demands
Walls use grid-snapped construction
Named carriage types, capacity, and exact limits remain TBA

topics.title: Fuel
topics.label: Branches, logs & charcoal
topics.description: Fuel keeps the Eden Engine moving and warm. Branches, logs, and charcoal have been named by the developer as fuel sources.
details: Fuel and power are connected but distinct operating concerns
Fuel consumption and burn times: TBA
Resource processing ratios: TBA

topics.title: Power
topics.label: Onboard systems
topics.description: The Eden Engine generates the power needed by the train and its facilities while also serving as the crew's major heat source.
details: Power management is a confirmed train responsibility
Consumers, grid limits, and generation values: TBA
Loss-of-power consequences beyond broad survival pressure: TBA

topics.title: Train defense
topics.label: Revenant attacks
topics.description: Train-defense encounters are being integrated with obstacle-clearing gameplay. Developers have also discussed Revenant waves and mounted weapons such as machine guns or cannons.
details: Train defense was listed in the May 2026 development update
Mounted weapons are a developer-described plan, not final balance data
Encounter schedules and damage values: TBA

locations.title: Frostrail Locations – Explore the Frozen North
locations.introduction: Plan stops across tundra routes, abandoned settlements, mining camps, bunkers, ruined strongholds, underground vaults, and modular dungeons. Each location can trade warmth and time for supplies, weapons, Relics, or a safer route onward.
locations.heroImageAlt: Frostrail train travelling through a frozen rail route

topics.title: Tundra
topics.label: Expanded biome
topics.description: The tundra is the game's principal open frozen biome. The May 2026 update reported that it had been expanded for further exploration.
details: Blizzards reduce visibility and movement
New points of interest are being artist-built rather than purely procedural
Named regions and map coordinates: TBA

topics.title: Modular dungeons
topics.label: Relic expeditions
topics.description: Dungeons use modular construction and were overhauled with updated lighting. They are a confirmed source of Relics, and the April test brief explicitly included early-game dungeon raids.
details: Layouts can vary and remain under development
Relics found inside can be activated aboard the train
An official screenshot shows the objective “The Trial Below — Search the unknown for a hidden shrine”
The screenshot proves an objective title, not a final dungeon or shrine name
Maps, loot tables, and complete enemy rosters: TBA

source.label: Official Steam media and Spring Development Update

topics.title: Abandoned settlements & wreckage
topics.label: Scavenging sites
topics.description: The official store description identifies abandoned settlements and wreckage as exploration and scavenging spaces.
details: Used to recover supplies and equipment
Environmental storytelling is part of the frozen empire premise
Individual settlement names and guaranteed loot: TBA

topics.title: Mining camps & villages
topics.label: Press-kit stop types
topics.description: The July 2026 Closed Beta press kit says crews stop at remnants of civilization, including old mining camps and villages, to forage for food and materials.
details: Named as forage stops, not as a finished world atlas
Food and materials are the stated finds
Canonical camp or village names: TBA

topics.title: Subterranean vaults
topics.label: High-reward interiors
topics.description: The same Closed Beta press copy says subterranean vaults hide powerful weapons and rewards. Treat this as a location type, not as a loot table or named vault list.
details: Described alongside mining camps and villages
Rewards are described as powerful weapons, not itemized
Relationship to modular dungeons: not separately mapped

topics.title: Derelict bunkers
topics.label: Enclosed location
topics.description: Derelict bunkers are one of the confirmed location types encountered beyond the rails.
details: Exact access requirements: TBA
Enemy and loot tables: TBA
No official bunker names have been published

topics.title: Ruined strongholds
topics.label: High-risk ruins
topics.description: Ruined strongholds and frozen ruins are named world features, but the developers have not yet disclosed their final map placement or reward structure.
details: Part of the former empire's frozen landscape
Specific threats, relics, and resources: TBA
Names and routes: TBA

topics.title: Levels & exits
topics.label: Branching journey north
topics.description: The journey advances north through connected levels. Crews can switch tracks, clear obstacles, and choose among exits or tunnels leading onward.
details: Terrain is mixed: hand-authored foundations with procedural natural assets, POIs, loot, and enemy placement
Current development builds carry progression between levels and support multiple exits
A developer interview says thorough exploration can exceed two hours, but final level duration is not fixed

topics.title: April playtest scope
topics.label: Tutorial + 2 areas
topics.description: The April 2026 test brief included the tutorial and two more game areas, giving the public a bounded sample rather than the final world map.
details: Tutorial plus two exploration areas
Early-game dungeons included
Scavenging, recycling, crafting, and train operation included
Area names and final map boundaries were not published

enemies.title: Frostrail Enemies – Know What Hunts Beyond the Train
enemies.introduction: Prepare for Revenant groups, wolves, ranged Corrupted Soldiers, and stranger horrors tied to the Void. These entries focus on how each threat pressures an expedition or train defense without inventing health, damage, or loot values that have not been shown.
enemies.heroImageAlt: Close combat against a hostile Revenant in Frostrail

topics.title: Revenants
topics.label: Zombified melee faction
topics.description: Lead designer Ez Jämsen describes Revenants as zombified enemies that mostly fight in melee and tend to attack in larger groups. Official gameplay-trailer press copy adds that the roar of the steam engine draws Revenants from the frozen wilds.
details: Encountered during exploration and discussed for planned train-defense waves
Engine noise is described as an attractor; no aggro radius value is published
New enemy variations were reported in May 2026
Health, damage, named variants, resistances, and drops: TBA

source.label: GamingBolt interview + official trailer press kit

topics.title: Wolves
topics.label: Confirmed creature
topics.description: The official mature-content disclosure explicitly names wolves among the enemy creatures players fight.
details: Combat can include blood effects
Specific wolf variants and behavior: TBA
Drops and spawn locations: TBA

topics.title: Corrupted Soldiers
topics.label: Planned ranged faction
topics.description: The lead designer identifies Corrupted Soldiers as a planned enemy faction that uses ranged weapons, appears in smaller groups, and is intended to behave more intelligently than Revenants.
details: Ranged combat role
Smaller groups and smarter behavior discussed
Weapon loadouts, armor, named classes, stats, and drops: TBA

topics.title: Eldritch horrors
topics.label: Beyond Revenants
topics.description: Official copy promises eldritch horrors beyond the more common Revenants.
details: Part of the Void-linked horror premise
Official train-defense screenshot of a large spiked quadrupedal threat
Boss or elite labels are not yet confirmed
Names, tactics, locations, and rewards: TBA

source.label: Official Steam description and screenshot gallery

topics.title: AI & enemy variations
topics.label: Work in progress
topics.description: Enemy AI, variation, usability, accessibility, and performance have all been cited as active development areas following playtests.
details: New variations reported in Spring 2026
AI improvement called out after the November 2025 test
Strategies may change significantly before Early Access

updates.title: Frostrail Updates – Closed Beta, Development News and Release Plans
updates.introduction: Follow Closed Beta dates, playtest changes, gameplay milestones, and the road to Steam Early Access without digging through old announcement feeds. Each update keeps the event date and the affected game systems easy to scan.
updates.status: Latest: Closed Beta live through September 7

topics.title: Closed Beta: live through September 7
topics.label: Verified September 5, 2026
topics.description: Frostrail's Closed Beta launched on August 31 and ends September 7, 2026. Accepted players and previous playtesters can play now, invite friends, and record or stream the test without an NDA. The main store can still show Request Access because this is not the general Early Access launch.
details: Beta period: August 31–September 7, 2026
Access: accepted players and prior playtesters
Friend invites: up to 3 per accepted player
No NDA for recordings or streams
Wishlists cited in the press kit: almost 500,000

topics.title: Almost 500,000 Steam wishlists
topics.label: July 2026
topics.description: In the Closed Beta press kit, lead designer Ez Jämsen said Frostrail had gained almost 500,000 Steam wishlists since reveal. This updates the earlier April 28 milestone of 400,000 and remains a wishlist count, not sales or concurrent players.
details: Source: July 2026 Closed Beta press kit
Prior official milestone: 400,000 on April 28, 2026
Not a player-count or revenue figure

topics.title: Spring Development Update
topics.label: May 13, 2026
topics.description: The team reported more than 100,000 playtest applications and detailed a new tutorial, cross-level progression, multiple exits, dungeon and tundra improvements, train defense, Relics, enemy variations, clothing, and repair workstations.
details: More than 100,000 playtest applications
Relics grant temporary buffs after activation aboard the train
Train defense and a reworked repair system were under active development

topics.title: 400,000 Steam wishlists
topics.label: April 28, 2026
topics.description: The team announced that Frostrail had passed 400,000 Steam wishlists. This is a wishlist milestone, not an active-player or sales count.
details: Announcement date: April 28, 2026
300,000 wishlists had been announced March 12
200,000 had been announced June 17, 2025

topics.title: First closed playtest
topics.label: April 16–May 4, 2026
topics.description: The first closed playtest began April 16, was originally scheduled through April 27, and was later extended to May 4. The test focused on the early gameplay loop and included a friend-invite chain.
details: Closed test; not an open beta
Focused on early-loop feedback
Progress and balance should not be assumed to carry forward

topics.title: Official gameplay trailer
topics.label: February 27, 2026
topics.description: Shiro Games published the official gameplay trailer showing the train, frozen exploration, crafting, and combat direction.
details: Gameplay trailer, not a complete feature catalog
Visual values and UI may change before release
Reveal trailer was published April 10, 2025

topics.title: Winter development update
topics.label: December 8, 2025
topics.description: Following a limited November playtest, the team said the core train-driving, exploration, and crafting loop worked while tutorials, AI, usability, accessibility, and performance still needed improvement.
details: Limited playtest in November 2025
Core loop was functional, not finished
Feedback informed continuing development

topics.title: Early Access window
topics.label: Q4 2026
topics.description: The official Steam store currently lists a Q4 2026 Early Access window. No exact public release date or price has been announced.
details: PC / Steam first
Planned Early Access duration: approximately one year
Price may increase at version 1.0
Exact release day and price: TBA
